rules.task_score: 100 x 1/2 x (violation recall + benign pass rate), over all labelled rows of each class
rules.failures: failed and no-decision rows earn no credit in either class; failure rate and conditional (decided-only) score are shown beside the task score
rules.threshold: fit on tuning rows only, once per implementation per subtask; max tuning task score, ties to lower tuning FPR then higher threshold; binary services keep their operating point (0.5); loaded from the frozen manifest, never refit
rules.secondary: highest tuning recall with tuning FPR <= 0.05; held-out recall and FPR reported
rules.suite: equal-weight mean of declared subtask scores (optional subtasks join only when evaluated)
rules.overall: equal-weight mean of the required suites; ranked only when every required suite is complete
rules.intervals: group bootstrap, 2000 replicates, 95% percentile, paired draws
rules.cost: USD per 1,000 evaluations from measured usage x dated tariff, or allocated serving time x hardware rate; unknown is null with a reason, never 0; suite cost = mean of subtask costs
rules.latency: p50/p95 over successful calls in the report rows; overall p95 weights each suite 1/6

change_from.change: word_filters gains a profanity subtask, equal weight with custom words; profanity_obfuscated is a diagnostic outside the score; nothing else changes

frozen_thresholds.rule: final mode scores test rows only at thresholds frozen in the manifest; nothing is refit
